parameter_provenance.V0: Table S1 row 12: 72.59 A^3 per conventional B1 cell, fixed from the stated LS/HS ratio 0.96. Preserve printed V0 rather than recomputing from the rounded ratio.
parameter_provenance.K0: Table S1 row 12: KT0 = 199 GPa fitted to LS XRD observations. No statistical uncertainty is printed.
parameter_provenance.K0_prime: Table S1 row 12: KT0 prime fixed at 3.5.
parameter_provenance.fit_selection: Table 2 source_order 24-29, P > 63 GPa; six LS observations. Mixed-spin rows are excluded.
parameter_provenance.derived_checkpoints: Table S1 KT columns at 69, 70.1, 75.8 and 81.2 GPa are derived LS model outputs, not additional observations. Columns at 45.9, 52 and 59 GPa include the mixed-spin population response and must not be compared with the pure-LS BM3 derivative.
parameter_provenance.summary_rows: min, max and avg summarize the ensemble by column; they are not three additional source fits. The average of nonlinear model curves is not generally the curve of the averaged coefficients.

superseded_record_text.label: Marquardt et al. (2009), EPSL LS BM3 Table S1 row 12
superseded_record_text.notes: One of 12 alternative constrained LS fits, not an independently preferred EOS. The six XRD observations above 63 GPa constrain K0 with V0 and K0 prime fixed. The ensemble range reflects assumed parameters, not statistical parameter errors.
validity_notes: Physical LS assignment is P > 63 GPa; measured XRD range is 63.9-77.4 GPa.
Table S1 evaluates LS moduli through 81.2 GPa; evaluations above 77.4 GPa extrapolate beyond the P-V observations.
Do not apply this pure-LS EOS to the mixed-spin region or use its extrapolated V0 as a measured ambient LS volume.
